title: Assistant Director (OG-2) - State Bank Officers Training Scheme (SBOTS)
education: Master's / Bachelor's (16 years) in Economics, Business Administration, Finance, CS, or Data Science
description: State Bank of Pakistan invites applications for Assistant Director (OG-2) under the 27th Batch of SBOTS. Selected candidates will undergo theoretical and practical training at the National Institute of Banking and Finance (NIBAF) before posting at SBP Headquarters or regional offices. Duties involve economic research, monetary policy formulation, and banking sector regulation.
requirements: Age limit: Maximum 26 years as of deadline (relaxable by 3 years for candidates from Gilgit-Baltistan, AJK, and Balochistan)
Qualification: 16 years of education with minimum 60% marks or 2.5/4.0 CGPA from HEC recognized university
Selection based on NTS written test followed by panel interviews

title: Secondary School Teacher (SST) (Male/Female)
organization: Federal Directorate of Education, Ministry of Federal Education & Professional Training
education: Second Class or Grade 'C' Master's Degree / 4-Year BS in relevant subject with B.Ed
description: Federal Public Service Commission is recruiting Secondary School Teachers for Federal Government Educational Institutions in Islamabad and Cantonments. The officers will deliver curriculum instruction, evaluate student performance, and participate in academic committee activities.
requirements: Age limit: 22 to 30 years plus 5 years general age relaxation (Total: 35 years)
Open to candidates nationwide under merit, Punjab, Sindh, KPK, Balochistan, and FATA/GB quotas
Must hold a professional degree in education (B.Ed / M.Ed) or equivalent qualification

title: Assistant Director (Software Engineering)
education: BS (CS) / BS (Software Engineering) / MIT (16 years education)
experience: 1 year relevant experience in web or mobile software development

requirements: Domicile: Eligible for Punjab Province domicile holders only
Age limit: Male 21 to 30+5=35 years; Female 21 to 30+8=38 years
Qualification: BSCS / BS Software Engineering (2nd Division) from HEC recognized institute

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Node.js & React)
education: BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent
experience: 4 to 6 years of hands-on software development experience

requirements: Strong proficiency in React.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and SQL/NoSQL databases
Proven experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure deployment, and CI/CD pipelines
Demonstrated experience in client management and agile software delivery methodology

title: Cyber Security Analyst
organization: National Information Technology Board (NITB), Ministry of IT & Telecom
education: BS in Cyber Security, Computer Science, or Information Security
experience: 3 years of experience in Security Operations Center (SOC) or threat mitigation
description: NITB is recruiting a Cyber Security Analyst to safeguard critical government digital infrastructure and data assets. Key responsibilities include continuous SIEM monitoring, vulnerability assessments, and coordinating rapid response to cyber threats.
requirements: Minimum 16 years education in Cyber Security / CS / IT from HEC recognized institution
Certifications like CEH, CompTIA Security+, or CISSP will be given preference
Maximum age 35 years as of the closing date of application submission

description: Meezan Bank's flagship Graduate Trainee Officer program offers fresh graduates structured career entry into Islamic Commercial Banking. Trainees undergo rigorous classroom training at Meezan School of Learning followed by branch rotations in retail, operations, and corporate finance.
requirements: Minimum 16 years of education with minimum 3.0 CGPA or 60% aggregate marks
Age limit: Maximum 26 years as of the deadline date
Strong analytical, interpersonal, and communication skills with commitment to Shariah principles

title: Junior Engineer (Civil)
education: B.Sc. Civil Engineering from recognized university
source: WAPDA Official Website / OTS Testing Portal

Age limit: 21 to 33 years (inclusive of general age relaxation)
Selection will be made on quota basis through competitive written screening test and interview
